news.headline: Delcath Systems (NASDAQ:DCTH) Sets New 52-Week High
news.summary: DCTH shares climbed to a new 52-week high near $17.42 in the days following the company's strong Q2 earnings report and subsequent analyst price target increases. The move extended a rally driven by accelerating HEPZATO KIT sales and raised full-year guidance.

news.headline: Delcath Systems to Participate at the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
news.summary: Delcath management attended the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference in Boston on August 11, 2026, presenting to institutional investors. The appearance came amid heightened investor attention following the company's Q2 earnings beat.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Price Target Raised to $32 from $30 at H.C. Wainwright
news.summary: H.C. Wainwright reiterated its Buy rating and raised its price target on Delcath to $32 from $30 following the company's Q2 2026 results. The increase reflected confidence in continued HEPZATO KIT demand momentum and the raised revenue guidance.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Highlights
news.summary: Delcath reported Q2 2026 total revenue of $29.1 million (up from $24.2 million a year earlier), with HEPZATO KIT revenue of $27.1 million and gross margin of 90%, beating analyst estimates and sending shares up over 9%. The company raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $104-$108 million and reported 31 active treatment centers, on track for 37 by year-end.

news.headline: Delcath Systems, Inc. Announces Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: Delcath granted 17,000 restricted stock units to four new employees who joined in May and June 2026, as material inducement awards under its 2023 Inducement Plan. The RSUs vest one-third after one year and the remainder over the following two years.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 2 Clinical Trial of HEPZATO in Liver-Dominant Metastatic Breast Cancer
news.summary: Delcath dosed the first patient at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan in its global Phase 2 DELUMA trial evaluating HEPZATO plus standard of care versus standard of care alone in liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer. The randomized trial plans to enroll roughly 90 patients across more than 20 sites in the US and Europe.

catalysts.label: 37 active U.S. treatment centers
catalysts.detail: Delcath expects to activate roughly six more HEPZATO treatment centers by year-end 2026 to reach a total of 37 active sites, up from 31 at the end of Q2 2026.

catalysts.label: Full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $104M-$108M
catalysts.detail: Management raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $104-$108 million after a strong Q2 beat, implying at least 28% HEPZATO volume growth over 2025.

catalysts.label: 40 active treatment centers target
catalysts.detail: Delcath expects to expand to roughly 40 active HEPZATO treatment centers by Q1 2027, with over 50 additional prospective centers in discussion.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Delcath is expected to report Q3 2026 financial results and business highlights in early-to-mid November 2026, consistent with its prior-year reporting cadence.

catalysts.label: Phase 2 mCRC trial primary endpoint (hPFS) readout
catalysts.detail: Interim/primary hepatic progression-free survival results from the Phase 2 trial of HEPZATO in liver-dominant metastatic colorectal cancer are anticipated around mid-2028, with overall survival data expected in late 2028.

catalysts.label: DELUMA Phase 2 breast cancer trial enrollment
catalysts.detail: Following first-patient dosing in July 2026, Delcath continues enrolling roughly 90 patients across 20+ US/European sites in its Phase 2 trial of HEPZATO in liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer, with data still pending.

pulse: Delcath is executing well on its HEPZATO KIT commercial ramp, with Q2 2026 revenue of $29.1 million (up ~20% year-over-year) beating estimates and prompting management to raise full-year 2026 guidance to $104-$108 million; shares have responded strongly, hitting a new 52-week high around $17.42 in mid-August and drawing fresh price-target increases from sell-side analysts (e.g., H.C. Wainwright to $32). The company is simultaneously expanding its U.S. treatment-center footprint (31 active, targeting 37 by year-end) and broadening its pipeline beyond uveal melanoma into metastatic colorectal cancer and, as of July 2026, metastatic breast cancer via the newly dosed DELUMA Phase 2 trial. Near-term risk factors include continued 340B pricing pressure on per-kit economics and the multi-year timeline before pipeline-expansion trials (colorectal, breast cancer) produce data, but current sentiment is clearly bullish on core HEPZATO adoption momentum.
